# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the interactive companion book for **MathCamp 2026**, the math camp
for the incoming Political Science PhD cohort. It replaces last year's
slide-based sessions (archived in `Resources/Slide Decks 2025/`) with
interactive, web-based material built in Quarto.

## How to use this book

Each session is its own chapter with two sub-chapters:

- **Slides** — the in-class slideshow (also browsable on its own at
  [`slides/index.html`](slides/index.html)).
- **Programming Lecture** — a webpage walking through the same material with
  runnable R code, worked examples, and (eventually) interactive
  visualizations via `plotly`, `Shiny`, or similar R tooling.

## Sessions

1. Notation, Functions, and Limits
2. Probability
3. Calculus I: Differentiation & Optimization
4. Calculus II: Integration & Multivariate Calculus
5. Linear Algebra
